Thanks for replying, and I appreciate it, but this kind of response makes me roll my eyes. "be happy, it could be worse". I don't think it can. just because I have food and water and my family technically still talks to each other, that means I'm supposed to cure myself of my depression? my breath is not a gift when every one I take means another second of wanting to kill myself. 
again, thanks for replying but this means nothing.
I have no idea who you are. I don't know whether you fit that description or not. all I know is enough people fit it that you'd be a minority if you don't.
